intro_section.title: Where Can You See Sloths From Papagayo?
paragraphs: Papagayo's dry tropical landscape is very different from the wetter forests where sloths are more commonly observed. Seeing sloths usually means traveling inland toward greener wildlife areas in northern Costa Rica.
A private tour makes that journey easier by combining direct resort pickup, transportation and a local guide into one experience — often with other Costa Rica highlights along the way.

faq.q: Where can I see sloths near Papagayo?
faq.a: Sloths are typically seen inland toward Bijagua or La Fortuna, both reachable from Papagayo as a private day trip. Papagayo itself is dry tropical forest, which is not prime sloth habitat.

faq.q: What is the best sloth tour from Papagayo?
faq.a: It depends on your priorities. The Hanging Bridges & Sloths Experience is our most popular overall pick, while the Sloth Adventure Tour is a more sloth-focused option and Sloth Adventure & Chocolate Tour adds a cultural chocolate-making experience.
No. Sloths are wild animals, so sightings can never be guaranteed. Local guides know where sloths are commonly observed and greatly improve your chances of spotting one.

faq.q: How far are sloth habitats from Peninsula Papagayo?
faq.a: Bijagua is roughly 1.7 to 2.2 hours away, and La Fortuna / Arenal is roughly 3 to 3.8 hours, based on real driving distance from Peninsula Papagayo.

faq.q: Are sloth tours suitable for families?
